doc: Initializes an object at a0: sets its update-function pointer (offset 0x10) to func_80051548, stores the passed-in a1 pointer at offset 0x20 and clears the two following short fields (0x24/0x26), then takes the linked sub-record pointer at offset 0xC and primes it (sets its 'fc' field to 0x808080) via func_8003DB94(sub, D_80072044, 0), sets two flag/state shorts on that sub-record (offsets 0x1C/0x1E) to 0x1000, invokes func_8004491C(a0, func_80044BB0) to register a callback, and finally fills a 3-word vector pointed to by offset 0x8 with fixed constants (0x1C00000, 0xC00000, 0x800000).
